scope: One read-only follow-up on the existing SuperNovaTracker depth/branch capture, save/restore and execution guard. No APD442 source or asset edits.

prior_review_check.excluded_completed: Talisman of Foresight own save/awareness paths are explicitly marked reviewed; those were not reopened.
prior_review_check.selected_effect: SuperNovaTracker is marked PENDING_SEMANTIC_REVIEW in the mechanics inventory. No explicit completed SuperNova branch/save investigation or existing SuperNova test was found in the consulted records/test source.
prior_review_check.cursed_wand_limit: Only its existing SuperNova creation call site was read to trace this buff. No Cursed Wand description, panel or owner decision was revisited.

method: Source-path inspection against the exact files in the completed APD442 fresh compilation; no new test or native execution.

checks.finding: Fresh creation captures both current depth and current branch in field initializers.
The sole creation call uses Buff.append, which constructs a fresh instance rather than reusing an old tracker context. The caller supplies position and ally-harm mode.
A branch OR depth mismatch returns from act before coordinates, FOV, halo, countdown decrement, explosion or map destruction are processed. Only actor scheduling time advances on that path.
fx(true) also requires matching depth and branch before creating the halo.

Position, depth, branch, turnsLeft and harmsAllies are explicitly saved and restored. Saved depth/branch replace the constructor defaults, so the global context during object allocation does not overwrite existing saved context.
The runtime FOV and halo references are not serialized; newly restored objects begin with those fields unset.

limits: This does not complete SuperNova semantic, combat, visual or balance review.
No new runtime regression or Android claim is made.
No statement is made about unspecified historical save formats missing existing fields.
No production, test, workflow, GitHub or Library mutations were performed.
